pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit polygonal, multi-sided geometries with relatively sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries. Geometric shapes range from irregular quadrilaterals to hexagons, with larger spatial areas on the flank compared to the neck and limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space consists of a light-colored interstitial network forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform on the mid-flank but widens significantly at the ventral transition and lower limbs.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark triangular patch is visible at the anterior base of the neck, possessing significantly lower pixel luminosity than the surrounding brown pelage patches.
